title: CppCon 2018: G. Nishanov “Nano-coroutines to the Rescue! (Using Coroutines TS, of Course)”
summary: Gor Nishanov's CppCon 2018 talk on using tiny C++ coroutines to hide memory latency, interleaving useful work while prefetches bring cache lines in from main memory.
why: Cited as a deep dive on coroutines for cache misses and on running huge numbers of coroutines without heap allocation.
